name: Talos Morning Brief
description: Weekday brief from your wiki and any read-only tools you have connected. Files at most five durable facts back into the wiki.

name: Talos Weekly Wiki Check
description: Runs the wiki linter and reports what is broken. Read-only: it fixes nothing.

name: Talos Weekly Snapshot
description: Commits memory, wiki and learnings to the agent's local git repo (named paths only). Local undo history, not an offsite backup.

name: Talos Memory Index
description: Refreshes the semantic search index (incremental; a no-op when nothing changed). A plain command: it runs the indexer directly and spends no Claude usage. Only useful after scripts/memory/setup.sh; ships disabled and is enabled by it.

name: Talos State Sweep
description: Daily read-only check of memory/STATE.md: size against the ceiling, rows that look finished, stale rows, dates coming up. Reports; edits nothing.

name: Talos Dream Cycle
description: Nightly memory consolidation that connects and flags, never rewrites: adds at most 15 verified '## Related' links to the wiki and queues contradictions and stale facts for you in memory/dream/QUEUE.md. Opt-in; one headless session a night; sends nothing.

name: Talos Watch AM
description: Quiet morning check-in: a plain command (no Claude, no model) that stays silent unless a calendar event is close, a STATE.md date is inside 48 hours, or an event changed. Needs ~/.config/talos/watcher.json; see setup/quiet-checkins.md. Ships disabled.

name: Talos Watch MID
description: Quiet midday check-in: a plain command (no Claude, no model) that stays silent unless a calendar event is close, a STATE.md date is inside 48 hours, or an event changed. Needs ~/.config/talos/watcher.json; see setup/quiet-checkins.md. Ships disabled.
